decision.reason: [ev-e598abf2a6cd] says delete_request_store must be set explicitly, either as `-compactor.delete-request-store` or as its YAML setting, when retention is enabled. The proposed condition has two problems. First, it checks only the CLI flag, so it would wrongly flag environments that set the store in YAML. Second, it relies on a `-compactor.retention-enabled` flag in state "set", but the evidence never names that flag or any key, and "set" would also match a value of false. The evidence does not say which flag or YAML key turns retention on, or where delete_request_store sits in the Loki config file. It also lists no config sources, so a correct exposure condition cannot be written from it.
